_comment: CURATED package metadata, merged into manifest.json by build_manifest.py.
categories is the canonical ORDERED list -- its order drives section order
on the website and in the installer picker. category_meta carries the
website's glyph and one-line pitch per category; packaging ignores it.
A package's `recommended: true` puts it in the picker's Recommended preset (the
first-run welcome); the CMS checkbox sets it, build_manifest.py derives `starter`.
Everything else in the manifest is derived live from the project -- this file
holds only what a machine cannot know: category and human description.
Descriptions were seeded by inspection and NEED OWNER REVIEW; correct them here
and re-run the generator. A package missing from this file still ships, with

Core.pitch: The registries every other tool plugs into. Installed as a unit.

Surfaces.pitch: The parts of TouchDesigner you look at all day, made yours.

Parameters.pitch: Promote, bind, randomize and reset — by drag and drop.

Network.pitch: Build, swap, collapse and navigate without touching a menu.

Media & Output.pitch: Where the picture and the sound actually leave the project.

Developer.pitch: Extensions, stubs and the editor you actually write them in.

AltSelect.description: Alternative selection helpers for operators in the network editor.

AutoCombine.description: Hold Alt while placing a generator TOP to have it come in pre-set to composite over its input.

AutoRes.description: Project-wide resolution reference that operators can follow instead of hardcoding pixel sizes.

BorderlessTD.description: Borderless TouchDesigner window, plus timeline hiding.

ColorUI.description: Operator and family colour palettes, with the active palette roaming through config.

CustomParTools.description: Promote parameters to a parent with binds or expressions, customize name/label/range on drop, plus extension creation, parent shortcuts, parameter clearing and IOP promotion.

ExprHotStrings.description: Abbreviations that expand into TouchDesigner expressions as you type in a parameter field.

FNS_ConfigRegistry.description: Settings persistence registry: one aggregated JSON in the user palette, so preferences follow you across projects and survive updates. The raw master, promoted to /sys.

FNS_Console.description: The toolkit's web front, served from inside your project: every tool's settings on one page, the install picker, and any tab a tool contributes. The raw master, promoted to /sys.

FNS_HotkeyManager.description: Unified hotkey discovery, conflict detection and rebinding UI across the whole toolkit.

FNS_Hub.description: The FNS button in TouchDesigner's main-menu bar and the one-stop manager window behind it: the Toolbar, Navbar and Main Menu configurators as tabs, the console, and any tab a tool contributes. Drop a panel COMP on the button to register it into a surface.

FNS_HubRegistry.description: The registry behind FNS_Hub's tab bar: tools contribute native panels, viewers or parameter pages as hub tabs. The raw master, promoted to /sys.

FNS_MainMenuRegistry.description: TD main-menu surface registry, including project-name display. The raw master, promoted to /sys.

FNS_Navbar.description: Pane-bar extras: parent-hierarchy navigation, path injection and drag-drop hijack, plus the navbar Configurator.

FNS_NavbarRegistry.description: The pane-bar surface registry. The raw master, promoted to /sys -- clone it to add your own pane-bar widgets.

FNS_OpMenu.description: OP Create dialog extras: the IO filter, operator search words and script injection.

FNS_OpMenuRegistry.description: OP Create dialog surface registry: search words, row decorations, right-click items, filter stages. The raw master, promoted to /sys.

FNS_PaneTypeRegistry.description: Named, persistent pane-type entries for TD's panebar: any COMP can appear in the pane-type dropdown and be recalled with configurable owner, type, window actions and callbacks.

FNS_Toolbar.description: Toolbar extras: the Configurator UI for ordering, grouping and hiding bar widgets, plus stock widgets.

FNS_ToolbarRegistry.description: The toolbar surface registry and mirror rail. The raw master, promoted to /sys -- clone it to put your own tools on the bar.

FNS_Updater.description: In-place toolkit updates, with settings preserved across the replacement.

GlobalOutSelect.description: Browse Global OP Shortcuts and the out operators inside them in a tree, and drag any of them into a network as a Select.

HydroHomie.description: A toolbar reminder to drink water at an interval you set. Off by default.

midiMapper.description: Map MIDI controls to parameters, with a learn mode you drive by dropping a parameter on the toolbar button. Mappings are saved into the project folder by design; the tool's own settings roam through config.

MISC.description: Assorted small utilities that ship together (hog CHOP, mouse input and friends).

MY_HOTKEYS.description: Convenience hotkeys over stock TouchDesigner actions: open parameters, open the COMP editor, focus the palette search.

OpenExt.description: Open an operator's extension source quickly.

OpTemplates.description: A library of preconfigured operator templates to drop into a network.

OpToClipboard.description: Copy the selected operator's reference to the system clipboard, ready to paste into an expression.

oscMapper.description: Map OSC messages to parameters. Mappings are saved into the project folder by design.

OUTPUT.description: Output window and display routing helpers.

ParOPDrop.description: Create Parameter CHOP/DAT and Parameter Execute DAT nodes inside a COMP from its custom parameters, by drag and drop or hotkey.

ParRandomizer.description: Randomize parameter values within range, for quick exploration.

paste_from_clipboard.description: Paste images and data from the system clipboard into TouchDesigner.

QuickCollapse.description: Collapse a selection into a component, with an optional customize dialog.

QuickMarks.description: Bookmark network locations and jump back to them. Bookmarks stay project-local by design.

QuickParCustom.description: Fast custom-parameter editing on the focused operator.

ResetPLS1.description: Reset stateful operators (feedback, cache, timers, counts) across the project, with a pattern-based exception list. Bound to ctrl+0.

SetSmoothness.description: Set Input/Viewer Smoothness on selected TOPs, or on every TOP in the network.

SwapOps.description: Swap one operator for another while keeping connections intact.

TDX_SearchPalette.description: Search field for TouchDesigner's palette browser, installed into the palette on startup. Vendored TD-SearchPalette by Yea Chen.

VSCodeTools.description: VS Code integration: open externalized scripts, sync files and generate TouchDesigner type stubs.
